options.content: Understand how your pages perform based on Google's key usability metrics: LCP (Largest Contentful Paint), INP (Interaction to Next Paint), CLS (Cumulative layout Shift).

panels.description: Interaction to Next Paint. Good: <200ms , Poor: > 500ms
panels.title: INP

panels.description: Interaction to Next Paint. Good: <200ms , Poor: > 500ms
panels.title: % with INP

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ${aggregation}(largestContentfulPaint) as timer,
$__timeInterval(timestamp) as time
FROM ${mpulse}
where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
AND if (empty ('${paramsU}'),true,paramsU like '${paramsU}')
AND $__conditionalAll(beaconTypeName in (${beaconTypeName:sqlstring}),${beaconTypeName})
AND $__conditionalAll(pageDomainName in (${pageDomainName:sqlstring}),${pageDomainName})
${filter}
${baseFilter}
group by time
order by time asc
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=LCP by Time; du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Measured values for Core Web Vitals items, as well as what percent of beacons contained a non-zero value for that measurement.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  ${groupBy} as ${groupBy},
  count(*) as count,
  ${aggregation}(largestContentfulPaint) as LCP,
  countIf(largestContentfulPaint>0)/count(*) as "% LCP",
  ${aggregation}(interactionToNextPaint) as INP,
  countIf(interactionToNextPaint>0)/count(*) as "% INP",
  ${aggregation}(cumulativeLayoutShift) as CLS,
  countIf(cumulativeLayoutShift>0)/count(*) as "% CLS",
  ${aggregation}(pageLoadTime) as PageLoad
FROM ${mpulse}
where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
AND if (empty ('${paramsU}'),true,paramsU like '${paramsU}')
AND $__conditionalAll(beaconTypeName in (${beaconTypeName:sqlstring}),${beaconTypeName})
AND $__conditionalAll(pageDomainName in (${pageDomainName:sqlstring}),${pageDomainName})
${filter}
${baseFilter}
group by ${groupBy}
order by count desc
LIMIT 1000
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=CWV by ...; du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Avg # of pages viewed in a session.

targets.rawSql:
with sessionTable as (
  SELECT sessionId,max(sessionPages) as sessionPages
  FROM ${mpulse}
  where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND if (empty ('${paramsU}'),true,paramsU like '${paramsU}')
  AND $__conditionalAll(beaconTypeName in (${beaconTypeName:sqlstring}),${beaconTypeName})
  AND $__conditionalAll(pageDomainName in (${pageDomainName:sqlstring}),${pageDomainName})
  ${filter}
  ${baseFilter}
group by sessionId
  )

select avg(sessionPages) as avgSessionPages
from sessionTable
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Session Length; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Session Length

targets.rawSql:
with sessionTable as (
  SELECT sessionId,max(sessionLatest) - min(sessionStart) as sessionDuration
  FROM ${mpulse}
where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
AND if (empty ('${paramsU}'),true,paramsU like '${paramsU}')
AND $__conditionalAll(beaconTypeName in (${beaconTypeName:sqlstring}),${beaconTypeName})
AND $__conditionalAll(pageDomainName in (${pageDomainName:sqlstring}),${pageDomainName})
${filter}
${baseFilter}

group by sessionId
  )

select avg(sessionDuration) as avgsessionDuration
from sessionTable
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Session Duration; du=${__user.login}'
